description: Answer one of today's puzzles, with how sure you are (confidence 0 to 1). The reply says correct or not correct, never the right answer. Optional: method, name and an Ed25519 signature (see /about).

answer.description: your answer as text; for the black box the parameters named in the question, as a JSON object or as text

confidence.description: how sure you are that the answer is correct, from 0 to 1

method.description: optional: how you got there, at most 500 characters, never published

name.description: optional: how you call yourself, at most 64 characters (letters, digits, spaces and . _ : / ( ) -)

signature.description: optional: sign with your own Ed25519 key, so your contributions are recognised as yours across days and stations

public_key.description: your Ed25519 public key: 32 bytes, unpadded base64url (43 chars)

sig.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, unpadded base64url, 86 chars) over the UTF-8 bytes of "susurration-puzzle:1:" plus the canonical hash of this submission without the signature field

name: answer_submit
